trail-sense.description:
Trail Sense is a free, open-source outdoor navigation and survival toolkit designed to work entirely offline. Built for hiking, camping, backpacking, geocaching, and wilderness exploration, it uses your Android phone's sensors to provide useful information even when there is no mobile signal.

Navigate using a compass, GPS coordinates, saved beacons, and recorded paths. Retrace your steps with Backtrack, explore imported offline maps, and use the astronomy tools to track the sun, moon, and celestial events. Weather monitoring uses available barometer measurements to estimate conditions and provide alerts.

Additional tools include a flashlight, clinometer, bubble level, pedometer, packing lists, field guide, and survival reference materials. Trail Sense also supports customizable tools and locally stored navigation information.

The app does not require an account or internet access, and location information stays on your device. Some features depend on hardware such as a compass or barometer. Predictions and sensor readings are not guaranteed accurate; always carry backup navigation equipment and appropriate wilderness skills.
